ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe displays a dominant white field with heavy black radial streaks emanating from the peduncle base. Right lobe is predominantly black with white mottling and a large, high-contrast white patch at the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 60-70 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the fluke horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with frequent, high-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys (serrations) present along the entire visible boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge, tapering to sharp, slightly upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-intensity white, circular pixel formations (barnacles) located at the extreme tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark linear streaks (rake marks) are visible, particularly on the right lobe, cutting across the natural pigmentation pattern in semi-parallel orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) across the right lobe and heavy calcified deposits/barnacle clusters at the distal extremities of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'feathered' or 'brushed' pixel transition between the white and black regions on the left lobe medial area.
